dataset: Grape Leaf dataset for leaf Health Classification and Disease Detection
split_method: StratifiedGroupKFold after grouping pHash Hamming distance <=6; no group crosses splits; no farm/site metadata.
limitations: Source labels are folder-derived and were not independently expert-reviewed by Dr Plant.
No orchard/site/plant/session metadata; only known exact and perceptual duplicates were grouped.
Archive has 3,001 raw entries although the source description claims 3,000.
The source reports 18,000 images including 15,000 augmented derivatives; only raw Process_Images entries were used.
No Syrian coastal field validation; exploratory research model only.
